headline: GE HealthCare expands breast imaging portfolio with Invenia ABUS Prime and launch of ABUS StreamVue
summary: CHICAGO, August 03, 2026--GE HealthCare today announced the launch of Invenia™ ABUS (Automated Breast Ultrasound) Prime and ABUS StreamVue™, a redesigned enterprise viewer that recently received U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) 510(k) clearance and CE Marking, expanding its breast imaging portfolio with solutions designed to support supplemental screening for women with dense breasts and provide more flexible enterprise-wide exam review.
